features.title: Add per-symbol position limits to the Account model and a POSITION_LIMIT reason
acceptance: Account.position_limits: dict[str, Decimal], empty by default (= no limits)
All existing tests and invariants still pass

features.title: Enforce the position limit in validate_order
acceptance: Orders that would take |net position| above the limit are rejected with POSITION_LIMIT
Exactly at the limit is allowed
Symbols with no configured limit are never limit-rejected
Unit tests for BUY and SELL, long and short

risks: Sign handling: SELL reduces a long position; a check on abs(position) + qty would block traders from closing positions.
Accounts already over a newly lowered limit must still be able to reduce exposure.
Flips through zero (long to short in one order) are neither plain reductions nor plain increases; the new opposite side must fit the limit (invariants 5 and 6).

The existing margin check runs on every order, so a reducing order can still be rejected for INSUFFICIENT_MARGIN. Pre-existing; conflicts with AGENTS.md rule 5. Flag for a human, do not change silently.
Do not use float when comparing Decimal quantities to the limit.
